title: Vegan Fajita Wraps
description: A delicious and easy-to-make vegan meal featuring marinated tofu and sautéed vegetables wrapped in a flavorful fajita wrap.
instructions: 1. Cut the tofu into small cubes and place in a shallow dish.
2. In a small bowl, mix together lime juice, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
3. Pour the marinade over the tofu and let it sit for at least 30 minutes, flipping occasionally.
4. Heat 1 tbsp of vegan oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Add the tofu to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
6. Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
7. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tbsp of vegan oil and sauté the chewy vegetables for 4-5 minutes, until tender.
8. Add the vegetarian fajita seasoning to the skillet and stir to combine.
9. Warm the fajita wraps according to package instructions.
10. Assemble the wraps by placing a portion of the sautéed vegetables and tofu onto a wrap, and serving immediately.
